counter_run.tool: perf instructions:u plus separate heaptrack process

aggregation: per side: arithmetic mean in ns of its two unrounded Criterion mean.point_estimate values; no weighting by iteration count; round only the final side mean to integer ps if subsequently producing approved policy rows
quantiles: per side: pool its 200 Criterion sample means (time_ns/iterations); nearest-rank ceil(p*N)-1 for p50/p95/p99; these are not individual-operation tail latencies
counter_scope: whole filtered Criterion process, including startup, all suite fixture setup, warmup/calibration and measured work; separate perf and heaptrack invocations; not per-operation counters; profiler timings never enter latency aggregation
failure_policy: all four complete runs are required; any failed/contaminated run invalidates the session; preserve every attempt and predeclare an entirely new session before any rerun; no best-run selection or threshold edits
